items.source: If type() is set to ASPECTJ, this is an AspectJ type pattern expression. If type() is set to REGEX, this is a regex pattern for the fully-qualified class names to match.
items.translation: 如果 `type()` 设置为 `ASPECTJ`，则这是一个 AspectJ 类型模式表达式。如果 `type()` 设置为 `REGEX`，则这是用于匹配完全限定类名的正则表达式模式。

items.source: Custom TypeFilters may optionally implement any of the following Aware interfaces, and their respective methods will be called prior to match:
items.translation: 自定义的TypeFilters 可选地实现以下任一Aware接口，其相应方法将在match之前被调用：

items.source: When multiple classes are specified, OR logic is applied — for example, "include types annotated with @Foo OR @Bar".
items.translation: 当指定多个类时，应用或逻辑——例如，“包含带有@Foo 或@Bar 注解的类型”。

items.source: The following table explains how the classes will be interpreted based on the configured value of the type() attribute.
items.translation: 下表解释了根据配置的 `type()` 属性值，类将如何被解释。

items.source:
Specifying zero classes is permitted but will have no effect on component
scanning.
items.translation: 指定零个类是允许的，但不会对组件扫描产生任何影响。

items.source: Declares the type filter to be used as an include filter or exclude filter.
items.translation: 声明要用作包含过滤器或排除过滤器的类型过滤器。

items.source: The pattern (or patterns) to use for the filter, as an alternative to specifying a Class value().
items.translation: 用于过滤器的模式（或模式），作为指定类 `value()` 的替代方案。

items.source: The class or classes to use as the filter.
The type of filter to use.
Chris Beams, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Chris Beams, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
